visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a black spaghetti strap tank top and grey cargo pants, sits on a light grey couch in a living room. She holds a black smartphone with a white plush bunny charm against her forehead and a white disposable cup to her lips, preparing for a photo. The background shows beige curtains and a small green object. (2) The perspective shifts to a POV shot from the forehead-mounted phone, showing a distorted close-up of the woman's nose and the plastic lid of the cup against a pink floral pillow. A camera shutter flash effect is visible. (3) The woman laughs hysterically while looking at her phone screen, showing the result to someone off-camera. She has a gold bracelet on her left wrist and dark nail polish. (4) Multiple takes follow with 'TAKE 2' and 'TAKE 3' text overlays, showing similar failed POV shots of her forehead or the top of the cup. (5) She displays her phone screen to the camera, revealing a Reel of a another creator successfully performing the trend. The video ends with her laughing and talking to the person filming her.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bouncy, high-tempo synthesizer BGM. A female voice speaks in an excited, high-pitched tone, followed by a loud, high-arousal burst of laughter. A digital 'click' sound effects, mimicking a camera shutter, triggers a phase shift. (2) Laughter dominates the mix, accompanied by breathy vocalizations as the female speaker struggles to speak through her amusement. The BGM continues with a consistent electronic beat. A second shutter SFX is heard. (3) A male voice enters with a moderate conversational pitch, sounding amused and teasing. He questions the woman's actions. The woman responds with a fast speech rate, defending her attempt at a trend, followed by more high-pitched laughter. (4) The female voice becomes more enunciated as she reads from a phone screen, while the male voice provides dry commentary. The BGM persists as a rhythmic bed, and the audio ends with a final swell of shared laughter and vocal high-arousal energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by documenting a failed attempt at a viral 'forehead selfie' trend, highlighting the humorous contrast between the expectation and the distorted reality.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The high contrast between the woman's actual appearance and the distorted 'nose-only' photos creates the core comedic effect.
